core_memory.user_introduction_michael: Michael, 35, lives in Seattle, freelance graphic designer, values design aesthetics in gadgets, interested in high-quality coffee machines to enhance his morning routine.
core_memory.user_shipping_inquiry_michael: Michael is in Seattle and is concerned about shipping times and origin. He wants to know if products are shipped from a local warehouse, and if not, what the delivery time frame is—especially since he has a family gathering later this month.
core_memory.user_warranty_inquiry_michael: Michael is inquiring about warranty policy for coffee machines, especially for higher-end models. He’s concerned about short warranty periods from other brands and wants assurance of a longer, more customer-friendly support period.
core_memory.user_temperature_inquiry_michael: Michael has had issues with drip coffee makers that don't heat sufficiently, leading him to microwave his coffee. He's asking whether your espresso machines have adjustable temperature settings or reliably produce hot coffee to enhance his at-home experience.
core_memory.user_inquiry_michael_steam_wand: Michael wants a machine with steam wand for latte/cappuccino. Enjoys strawberry matcha. Kitchen counter is 38 sq ft; may need to move toaster oven.
core_memory.user_inquiry_michael_return_policy: Michael asks if return shipping is required. He's cautious due to past bad experiences. He wants a clear, customer-friendly policy on defects or size issues.
core_memory.user_inquiry_michael_coffee_grinder_reco: Michael wants a coffee grinder that pairs with his stainless-steel espresso machine. He values fresh beans and aesthetic harmony with his kitchen design.
